Kelly & Stone Architects (KS|a) | Truckee, CA (Lake Tahoe) and Steamboat Springs, CO (Rocky Mountains)
GROW QUICKLY. DESIGN MEANINGFULLY. LIVE FULLY.
KS|a is a design-driven firm creating custom residential homes in some of the West's most striking settings. Our teams are small and collaborative, so architects take on real responsibility early. We believe great design and a great quality of life go together.
We're hiring a licensed Project Architect at Level II or Level III, depending on experience, to join our Truckee or Steamboat Springs studio. This is an in-office position.
Project Architect II
$85,000–$110,000 depending on experience · 6+ years · In-office, Truckee or Steamboat Springs
For a licensed architect ready to run projects day to day with a principal's support. You'll own the technical side of high-end custom homes, from schematic design through construction, and get real mentorship along the way, not production-only work.
What you'll do
Manage projects day to day from schematic design through construction administration
Develop design concepts with the principal and help shape design direction
Produce and lead construction documents and detailing in ArchiCAD
Coordinate consultants (structural, civil, MEP, landscape, interiors) and integrate their work
Prepare permit and design review submittals and respond to plan check comments
Work directly with clients at meetings and presentations
Support construction administration: site visits, RFIs, submittals and field questions
Collaborate in a team of 2–3 people per project
What you bring
Licensed architect with 6+ years of professional experience
Strong residential design and technical execution skills
Proficiency in ArchiCAD and construction documentation
Experience leading projects and working with clients
Clear communication and a collaborative mindset
Interest in growing into a Level III / project leadership role
Project Architect III
$95,000–$140,000 depending on experience · 8+ years · In-office, Truckee or Steamboat Springs
For an experienced licensed architect who wants lasting influence. You'll lead high-end custom residential projects from concept through construction, guide design direction, mentor the next generation of our team and help shape where the firm goes next.
What you'll do
Lead projects from concept through construction as the client's main point of contact
Guide design direction while staying hands-on in the design itself
Oversee construction documents and detailing in ArchiCAD for quality and constructability
Lead consultant teams and keep scope, schedule and fees on track
Manage permitting and design review with the jurisdictions where we build
Lead construction administration with contractors through completion
Mentor junior team members and review their work
Gain exposure to firm strategy and long-term business planning
What you bring
Licensed architect with 8+ years of professional experience
Strong residential design and technical execution skills
Proficiency in ArchiCAD and construction documentation
Demonstrated experience leading projects and client relationships
Experience mentoring or managing others
Interest in long-term leadership within a boutique firm
Benefits (Both Levels)
Paid time off
Health insurance
Healthy living benefit
401(k) with employer match
Support for licensure and professional accreditation
Why KS|a: real ownership on small teams, direct client relationships, a relaxed and unpretentious studio, 40-hour weeks with rare (planned) overtime, and yes, midweek skiing.
How to Apply
Apply online at ksapin-up.lovable.app/apply: upload your resume and portfolio and choose your preferred studio. You can also email PDFs (labeled with your name and the date, under 10MB total) to [email protected]. We review applications weekly and will reach out to candidates we'd like to meet.
